headline_hook: MiniMax M3 Goes Open-Weight, Codex Gets DevTools, and Fable Ships Real Projects

pick_of_the_day.thesis: When the loudest safety advocate proposes governance only their lab survives, the 'safety vs openness' debate reveals itself as a market structure argument — and builders need to recognize the difference before they pick a side.

model_literacy.concept: Mixture of Experts (MoE) — Active vs Total Parameters
model_literacy.relevance: MiniMax M3 has 428B total parameters but only activates 23B per token — understanding MoE explains why a model can be massive yet cheap to run, and why 'parameter count' alone no longer predicts cost or speed.

items.title: MiniMax M3 Drops 428B Open-Weight MoE With Only 23B Active Parameters
items.angle: The efficiency ratio is the headline — a model this large running this lean, fully open-weight and pip-installable day one, resets what 'open-source competitive' means against frontier closed models.
items.key_fact: 428B total / 23B activated parameters, open-weight on HuggingFace with Transformers v5.12 native support

items.title: Moonshot AI Drops Kimi K2.7 Code Into the Open-Weight Ring
items.angle: The open-weight coding model field now has serious Chinese lab entrants alongside Cohere and Meta — the supply of competent coding models is becoming abundant.
items.key_fact: Dedicated coding variant from Moonshot AI, open-weight on HuggingFace

items.title: Google Opens Project Genie Globally for Ultra 5X Subscribers
items.angle: Google is mirroring Anthropic's premium capability tiers — the most advanced AI features are now explicitly gated behind premium subscriptions across all major labs.
items.key_fact: Project Genie now available globally for Google AI Ultra 5X subscribers

items.title: Codex Gets Chrome DevTools Protocol — Real Browser Debugging From Inside the Agent
items.angle: JavaScript profiling, network inspection, and page state debugging from within the agent makes Codex genuinely viable for frontend work — not just code generation, but live debugging.
items.key_fact: Chrome DevTools Protocol access for JavaScript profiling, network debugging, and page state inspection

items.title: GitHub Copilot Code Review Now Supports MCP and Custom Agent Skills
items.angle: Bringing org-specific tools and standards directly into the PR review flow is the extensibility unlock enterprise teams have been waiting for.
items.key_fact: MCP server connections and custom agent skills in public preview for code review

items.title: Claude Code Ships Three Releases in a Day Post-Fable
items.angle: The shipping cadence — localized sessions, Bedrock caching, scroll controls — signals how aggressively Anthropic is iterating on developer tooling while Fable attention is high.
items.key_fact: v2.1.174–176: localized session titles, Bedrock credential caching, scroll acceleration

items.title: Transformers v5.12 Ships Same-Day MiniMax M3 Vision-Language Support
items.angle: HuggingFace's ecosystem velocity means new models go from announcement to pip-installable within hours — the infrastructure layer is no longer the bottleneck.
items.key_fact: MiniMax-M3-VL support with CLIP-style tower and 3D rotary position embeddings

items.title: Simon Willison Goes From Fable Skeptic to 'Relentlessly Proactive' Convert
items.angle: One of the loudest Fable 5 critics now shows it spinning up custom CORS servers and debugging tools autonomously from a single screenshot — the critic-to-convert arc is itself a signal about the model's practical capability.
items.key_fact: Fable autonomously created Python CORS proxy servers and debugging tools from a screenshot

items.title: How to Manage Fable's Overwhelming Output in Long Agentic Sessions
items.angle: Anthropic's own developer relations lead shares a concrete prompting pattern for taming Fable's proactivity — practical technique for anyone hitting the 'too much output' wall.
items.key_fact: Specific prompt snippet for controlling output volume in extended agent conversations

items.title: Fable 5 Hits 87–88% on FrontierMath Without Being a Reasoning Specialist
items.angle: Independent benchmark confirmation from Epoch AI — these scores from a non-reasoning-specialized model suggest the gap between 'general' and 'reasoning' models is closing fast.
items.key_fact: 87% on FrontierMath Tiers 1–3, 88% on Tier 4 (independently verified by Epoch AI)

items.title: Frontier LLMs Now Outperform Purpose-Built Clinical AI Across the Board
items.angle: General-purpose models beating specialized clinical tools in all three evaluations is a death knell for vertical AI products built on older architectures.
items.key_fact: Frontier LLMs outperformed clinical AI tools in all three evaluation categories

items.title: Microsoft Research Ships Arbor — a Generalist Autonomous Research Agent
items.angle: Persistent hypothesis-tree refinement is a structural advance over linear agent chains — the field is moving past task-specific agent designs toward generalist research autonomy.
items.key_fact: Uses persistent hypothesis-tree refinement for autonomous research across domains

items.title: 48 Hours of Fable 5: The Community Build Showcase That Benchmarks Can't Capture
items.angle: Official Claude account curates the most impressive community projects built in Fable's first 48 hours — what people actually ship with a model matters more than what it scores.
items.key_fact: 29,885 likes on the community showcase thread — highest engagement of any Fable post

items.title: LeCun Fires Back: Amodei's Safety Governance Would Kill Open-Source AI
items.angle: The sharpest counter-argument to Anthropic's policy positioning — 'declare AI too dangerous for competition, then propose a regime only your lab survives' — forces the industry to separate safety arguments from market structure arguments.
items.key_fact: 1,985 likes — LeCun's most-engaged AI policy post this month

items.title: TCS Partners With Anthropic to Push Claude Into Banks and Government
items.angle: Following DXC yesterday, Anthropic is systematically locking down the enterprise consulting layer — TCS gives Claude a direct channel into regulated industries worldwide.
items.key_fact: TCS is one of the world's largest IT services firms serving banks, insurers, and government agencies

items.title: Anthropic Publishes Its First 'Public Record' With Chris Olah on the Pope's AI Encyclical
items.angle: A new transparency initiative that bridges AI safety with broader societal discourse — Anthropic is deliberately positioning itself in conversations beyond the tech bubble.
items.key_fact: First release in a new 'Public Record' series combining AI safety with societal perspectives

items.title: Richard Socher Claims Recursive Has Achieved Self-Improving AI Research
items.angle: Whether you believe the claim or not, serious researchers saying 'AI agents are now doing our AI research' in public signals where the frontier labs think they're headed.
items.key_fact: Recursive claims agents are doing the research that makes better agents

items.title: Extend CLI Open-Sources Document Parsing With Built-In Agent Skills
items.angle: CLI tools shipping with agent skills baked in is becoming the pattern — this is how the tool ecosystem adapts to agentic workflows where Claude Code or Codex drives execution.
items.key_fact: Built-in agent skill so Claude Code and Codex can drive document parsing natively

items.title: architect-loop: Fable as Architect, Codex as Builder — Cross-Vendor Agent Arbitrage
items.angle: The first clean implementation of model arbitrage in a practical dev tool — use the best model for each phase instead of locking into one vendor for everything.
items.key_fact: Claude Code skill routing architectural decisions to Fable and code-writing to GPT-5.5 Codex

items.title: Step-by-Step: Setting Up a Local Coding Agent on macOS
items.angle: Fills the gap between 'coding agents exist' and 'here's exactly how to run one on your machine' — trending on HN for a reason.
items.key_fact: 226 HN points, practical macOS-specific walkthrough
